meaning: Line 357 builds an uncompiled copy of the same assembly only to read its unknown list, beside the compiled system on line 360. It fixes what counts as a state variable name for anything downstream that consumes vars_raw.

could_move.what: Any m5 fit run, since the model is assembled through this call
Replotted traces if plotting resolves variables by name from vars_raw
Comparison of m5 against patient data

expectation: Unknown. The uncompiled system at 357 does not itself enter the solve, so any effect depends on how vars_raw is used later; the element sort at line 355 can also change variable ordering. I cannot tell from this context whether solved trajectories move.

check.why: Re-runs the existing m5 verification on one model instead of a full re-fit, so a change in assembly or variable naming surfaces quickly.
